dogecoin.text: Key metric: $DOGE 1-month ROI still -27% despite pump. Retail conflates Trump’s DOGE acronym with the coin – 83% of tweets analyzed miss the distinction. Never underestimate the market’s capacity to meme itself into bagholding.

SoCatis: Trump’s ‘DOGE’ department narrative collides with $DOGE price – Musk’s gov role sparks 8% pump then 3.2% dump post-denial. Sentiment split: retail memes efficiency gains vs OGs fearing SEC data access. Political memecoins = volatility squared.
